scope: Observed outcome-disparity screening, four-fifths favorable-outcome ratios, predictive disparity screening, equalized-odds support/privacy, configuration validation, population alignment, and downstream integrity.
confirmed_findings_fixed: Prediction fairness previously accepted partial current-employee coverage.
Prediction fairness previously accepted stale or extra employee IDs.
Prediction fairness could remain available with no complete valid finite probability population.
Equalized-odds output exposed reconstructable small outcome-class counts.
Malformed minimum-group-size configuration did not fail closed consistently.
Demographic-parity totals could reconstruct a suppressed protected-group size by subtraction.
Summary status could claim no material disparity while protected-group evidence was suppressed.
A stale deterministic-evidence regression contract expected disclosure of an unsupported one-person class and was migrated to the governed suppression contract.
interpretation_boundary: Fairness outputs are descriptive screening signals, not legal, causal, discrimination, compliance, or bias determinations. Suppressed evidence prevents a no-disparity conclusion.
remaining_scientific_limits: Intersectional support and uncertainty still require organization-specific validation.
Selection bias and outcome-definition validity are not established by synthetic tests.
Predictive fairness metrics do not establish future-horizon calibration or legal fairness.
